facts.text: Grand Hyatt Fukuoka is in the Hakata district in the heart of Fukuoka City.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hyatt Fukuoka is a luxury hotel located in the Hakata district in the heart of Fukuoka City, Japan.

facts.text: The hotel is connected to Canal City Hakata, a complex of business, entertainment and shopping facilities.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is connected to Canal City Hakata, a multidimensional complex of business, entertainment and shopping facilities.

facts.text: The first floor of Canal City Hakata is connected to the hotel's lobby level.
facts.excerpt: The first floor of Canal City Hakata is connected to the lobby level of our hotel.

facts.text: Kushida Shrine, Sumiyoshi Shrine, the Rakusuien Japanese garden and the Hakata Machiya Folk Museum are all within a few minutes' walk.
facts.excerpt: Visit several key cultural highlights of the city like the Kushida Shrine, the Sumiyoshi Shrine, the Rakusuien Japanese garden and the Hakata Machiya Folk Museum—all within a few minutes

facts.text: Rooms and suites embody an East meets West style.
facts.excerpt: embody an “East meets West” style of accommodations

facts.text: Depending on the room type, rooms have city views or views of Canal City Hakata.
facts.excerpt: Depending on the room type, guests may enjoy either city views or views of Canal City Hakata, the shopping and entertainment complex located directly next to the hotel.

facts.text: Rooms have spacious bathrooms with large tubs and separate showers.
facts.excerpt: Our rooms feature plush beds, branded amenities and spacious bathrooms with large tubs and separate showers.

facts.text: The renovated Premium rooms have a Tea Bar and interiors inspired by local art and craftsmanship.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully designed with a Tea Bar and interiors inspired by local art and craftsmanship, this 34-square-meter room offers an authentic stay that reflects Fukuoka's culture.

facts.text: The Hakata Suite has a Tea Bar, a dining table with integrated tea-making facilities and interiors inspired by local art and craftsmanship.
facts.excerpt: Thoughtfully designed with a Tea Bar, a spacious dining table with integrated tea-making facilities and interiors inspired by local art and craftsmanship, this suite offers

facts.text: The Japanese Suite is a ryokan-style room with futon sleeping on Japanese-style bedding, recommended for families.
facts.excerpt: This ryokan-style guestroom offers sleep on a futon with Japanese-style bedding, and is recommended for family guests.

facts.text: The Japanese Deluxe Suite has a Japanese tea ceremony room plus two tatami-mat rooms.
facts.excerpt: This 85-square-meter Japanese suite consists of a Japanese tea ceremony room, as well as an eight-tatami-mat room and a six-tatami-mat room.

facts.text: From the hinoki soaking tub in the Japanese Deluxe Suite, guests can view a private Japanese garden.
facts.excerpt: From the bathroom with its hinoki soaking tub, guests can enjoy the view of a private Japanese garden.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite has living, dining and work areas and a full kitchen.
facts.excerpt: two plush king beds, spacious living, dining, and work areas, a full kitchen, and a deluxe bathroom provide exceptional comfort and convenience

facts.text: The Grand Club lounge on the 5th floor serves breakfast, refreshments and an evening cocktail hour for Grand Club room and suite guests.
facts.excerpt: The lounge offers exclusive food and beverage services, including breakfast, refreshments and evening cocktail hour; guests can also enjoy check-in, checkout and concierge services.

facts.text: Club Olympus is a relaxation facility exclusively for hotel guests and club members.
facts.excerpt: Club Olympus is a total relaxation facility exclusively for hotel guests and club members.

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor swimming pool.
facts.excerpt: Maintain your swim routine in our stunning indoor swimming pool

facts.text: The spa, AN SPA FUKUOKA, is in Club Olympus.
facts.excerpt: Treatments are available at AN SPA FUKUOKA in Club Olympus.

facts.text: THE MARKET F restaurant centers on an open kitchen and charcoal grill.
facts.excerpt: Experience a striking open kitchen and charcoal grill at the heart of the restaurant, where guests are immediately immersed in the energy of live fire.

facts.text: Bar Fizz serves cocktails, wines and spirits with live music.
facts.excerpt: Bar Fizz is the perfect place to unwind and enjoy a variety of cocktails, wines and spirits while being entertained by live music.

facts.text: Several standard and Club Access rooms are suitable for up to 2 adults and rollaway beds cannot be used in them.
facts.excerpt: This room is suitable for up to 2 adults and please note rollaway beds cannot be used in this room.

facts.text: The Grand Ballroom has a glass chandelier and the Savoy room has a marble stone chandelier.
facts.excerpt: The luxurious glass chandelier in the Grand Ballroom and the stylish marble stone chandelier in Savoy create an elegant environment.

facts.text: Spa treatments use aroma oil or Shiatsu massage therapy.
facts.excerpt: Immerse yourself in luxurious treatments using aroma oil or Shiatsu massage therapy to correct imbalances in the body.
